Courses at the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Guwahati.

## Current Semester

### CS1214 — Object Oriented Programming and Data Structure Lab

A laboratory course covering object-oriented programming principles and the design, implementation, and analysis of fundamental data structures — classes, inheritance, polymorphism, templates, lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and hash tables.
